source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line = next(v for v, _ in counts.most_common() if v != fill)
    markers = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != fill and grid[r][c] != line}
    if not markers:
        return [[fill]]
    marker_rows = [r for r, _ in markers]
    marker_cols = sorted({c for _, c in markers})
    rmin, rmax = min(marker_rows), max(marker_rows)
    node_rows = [r for r in range(rmin, rmax + 1)
                 if sum(v != fill for v in grid[r]) >= 0.7 * w]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(node_rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(marker_cols) - 1):
            r0, r1 = node_rows[i], node_rows[i + 1]
            c0, c1 = marker_cols[j], marker_cols[j + 1]
            a, b = grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1]
            c, d = grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]
            if a == b == c == d and a not in (fill, line):
                row.append(a)
            else:
                row.append(fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line = next(v for v, _ in counts.most_common() if v != fill)
    markers = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != fill and grid[r][c] != line}
    if not markers:
        return [[fill]]
    marker_rows = [r for r, _ in markers]
    marker_cols = sorted({c for _, c in markers})
    rmin, rmax = min(marker_rows), max(marker_rows)
    node_rows = [r for r in range(rmin, rmax + 1)
                 if sum(v != fill for v in grid[r]) >= 0.7 * w]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(node_rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(marker_cols) - 1):
            r0, r1 = node_rows[i], node_rows[i + 1]
            c0, c1 = marker_cols[j], marker_cols[j + 1]
            a, b = grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1]
            c, d = grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]
            if a == b == c == d and a not in (fill, line):
                row.append(a)
            else:
                row.append(fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
